subject: Northwind Robotics - Online Coding Assessment
body:
Hi João,

Thanks for your interest in the Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2027 role. As a next step, please complete our HackerRank coding assessment (90 minutes, 3 problems).

Link: https://hackerrank.example/northwind-swe-2027
Please complete it by Monday, October 19 at 11:59 PM Pacific.

Best,
Northwind Robotics University Recruiting

mock_response.summary: 90-min HackerRank OA, due Mon Oct 19 11:59pm PT
